meta.title: Brand name only; legal entity reachable via alias fixture; sponsorship offered

payload.requisition_text:
Backend Engineer (Python) at Loopwork
London Bridge · Hybrid (3 days/week)

Loopwork is the rota and payroll app used by 900+ UK hospitality venues. Shift workers see their hours, swap shifts and get paid correctly; managers stop doing rotas in spreadsheets at midnight.

You'll build the payroll calculation engine: pension auto-enrolment, holiday accrual, tribunal-proof audit trails. Python, PostgreSQL, a little Go at the edges.

We look for 1-2 years of production backend experience and care for getting money calculations exactly right.

£43,000 + options. 25 days holiday plus your birthday. We sponsor Skilled Worker visas for this role and have done so for several of the team. Interviews are two stages plus a paid half-day pairing session.

expected.determining_fact: Loopwork is operated by Ashcombe Digital Ltd, a licensed A-rated Skilled Worker sponsor; the posting offers sponsorship and the salary clears both thresholds.

evidence_anchors.willingness_quote: We sponsor Skilled Worker visas for this role

design_notes: The Deliveroo/Roofoods archetype pointed the harmful direction: everything is genuinely sponsorable, but Loopwork appears on no register row and the legal entity is never named in the posting. Ctrl-F resolution returns no match and produces a false NOT_SPONSORABLE, discarding a viable role. Resolution must come from aliases.json.
